external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and orders socks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile app through which customers browse and order.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app and marketing spreadsheet macros to handle customer and order data.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: The description states that nobody can tell what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that dials the number stored against an order and faxes a confirmation.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: Nobody checks whether the fax arrived at the right place.

processes.name: catalogue macros
processes.description: Spreadsheet macros that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: The description does not state whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file containing delivery addresses.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it
data_stores.notes: Only addresses are stored in the file. The description does not state whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet containing the marketing catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: place orders
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
data_flows.notes: The description does not state what authentication the API uses.

data_flows.name: store customer data
data_flows.description: The web API keeps customer data in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer names, addresses, and the card they paid with.

data_flows.name: hand over order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order, and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: The catalogue macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: customer mobile device
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-controlled mobile-device zone containing the mobile app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office zone where the marketing laptop and catalogue spreadsheet are located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app and customer are in a customer-controlled mobile-device zone.
assumptions.basis: The text describes customers using a mobile app; the app is inferred to run on the customer's mobile device.

assumptions.assumption: The customer is in the customer-controlled mobile-device zone.
assumptions.basis: The text describes customers using a mobile app; the customer is inferred to use their own mobile device.
It contains customer names, addresses, and payment-card data.
It contains delivery addresses, which are personal data.
It contains commercially sensitive catalogue prices and product copy.
